title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion Binance says the attacker reportedly gained access through a compromised employee laptop, and about $3 billion has been frozen onchain. This post Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
